hints.title: Complete Duplicate Purge Obstacle
hints.text: Keeping the first instance of a duplicate violates the requirement to purge all repeated numbers. How can you detect if head matches head.next before deciding to advance your predecessor pointer?

hints.title: Duplicate Lookahead Splicing Invariant
hints.text: When curr.next and curr.next.next have matching values, skip all consecutive nodes sharing that value by bypassing curr.next.

hints.title: Sentinel Lookahead Sub-chain Deletion Procedure
hints.text: Create a dummy node pointing to head and set curr to dummy. While curr.next and curr.next.next exist: if their values match, extract that duplicate value and advance curr.next while curr.next has that value. If values differ, advance curr to curr.next.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in list (0 <= N <= 300)
complexity.notes: Single pass skipping all duplicate chains in-place.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard unique-filtering that retains the first occurrence of each key leaves repeated values in the output.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lookahead value comparison skips duplicate chains in O(1) space without extra frequency counters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of sentinel dummy head to handle deletions at the start of the list.
